ideas.title: The Impact of Federal Funding Freeze on Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the effects of the federal funding freeze on Minnesota's social services and vulnerable populations.
questions: How will the funding freeze affect Minnesota's social services?
What are the potential consequences for vulnerable populations?
ideas.insight: This story could expose the human impact of the funding freeze and shed light on potential solutions.

ideas.title: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the $3.2 million Medicaid fraud scheme involving a Minneapolis duo and explore potential connections to larger healthcare program fraud.
questions: How widespread is Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What are the implications for healthcare programs?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal a larger issue with Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and highlight the need for increased scrutiny of healthcare programs.
